English

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

pantalone (plural pantalones)

  1. Alternative form of pantaloon (“buffoon”).

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
    • IPA(key): /pan.taˈlo.ne/
    • Audio:(file)
    • Rhymes: -one
    • Hyphenation: pan‧ta‧ló‧ne

    Noun

    [edit]

    pantalone m (plural pantaloni, diminutive pantaloncìni (plural), pejorative pantalonàcci (plural))

    1. (usually in the plural) trousers; trouser suit
